name: proschi-backend
description: Sign-in and practice stats for Proschi, on Cloudflare Workers and D1

scripts.predev: npm run problems && npm run cards && npm run game
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run problems && npm run cards && npm run game
scripts.pretest: npm run problems && npm run cards && npm run game
scripts.predeploy: npm run problems && npm run cards && npm run game
scripts.deploy: npm run backup && wrangler d1 migrations apply proschi --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.predeploy:staging: npm run problems && npm run cards && npm run game
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply proschi-staging --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
